name: repo-issues
description: Claude Code plugins for the issues, docs and infra CLIs (RepoIssuesCli, RepoDocsCli, RepoInfraCli).

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: Track work as issues stored in the repository with the issues CLI.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Find, maintain and prune agent docs stored in the repository with the docs CLI, with hooks that push matching docs and flag stale ones.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Write and run infrastructure stored in the repository with the infra CLI, with a guard hook that asks before infra changes anything and an edit hook that validates .repo-infra Luau.
